payload.text: ONCE 0154 LANDS, A FLEET SWEEP FREEZES NOTHING THE MACHINE HAS NOT DECLARED (its rider, on hv's 2026-10-03 ruling that devbin keeps no list of who uses it). The fleet roots take in a directory of archived estates, so a sweep's dry run plans every estate there, and its plan line reads 'frozen: none declared'. This release has no sweep: hv upgrades the estates as hv goes. If one is ever on the table, hv decides where the machine declares DEVBIN_FLEET_FROZEN before anything is applied (directives 3, 5 and 12). Raised by cc on 2026-10-03.
